summary: @servicetitan/contentful executes obfuscated Bun payload at install time via preinstall dropper
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (or reuses a pre-existing `bun`), extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) with obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotated string array, `_0x`/random identifiers, no recoverable strings or URLs). The obfuscated bundle is unrelated to the package's stated Contentful-helper purpose, and its content is only reachable through the downloaded alternate runtime, which bypasses Node-level instrumentation. The legitimate-looking `dist/index.js` re-export is decoupled from this install-time payload; the shape is consistent with a compromised-scope or typosquat publish under `@servicetitan/*` that ships an opaque payload while retaining the appearance of an ordinary library. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine under the downloaded Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
